systems.owner: Judicial authorities (announced at the Supreme Court's 65th anniversary, 2 June 2026)

systems.tiers: One of six applications (Logipenal, Logicivil, INFO, PAC, ILO, IGAP) in use within courts for civil, criminal, commercial and land cases; authorities acknowledge they do not yet cover the whole territory

note: Justice-sector systems only: a criminal records platform in development (identification) and the courts' own case applications, which are not the police's and are named without a link to police or gendarmerie. Nothing on station records.
